name: DALK
source: A war between the god Matis and a group of rival goddesses called Mira leaves Matis sealed away in a deserted temple. To break the seal a young monk and a group of female adventurers will have to get to the top of a mountain and seal away the goddesses of Mira in the process.
translation: 神明马蒂斯与名为米拉的敌对女神集团爆发战争，马蒂斯最终被封印在一座废弃神殿中。为了解除封印，一名年轻僧侣和一群女性冒险者必须登上山顶，并在途中逐一封印米拉的众女神。
